text.aria-label: Title text 'Safe-side share by phase of an injected load-shift: 3, 7, 15, and 30 day events, both groups, 24-120 h ahead Safe side: below q95 if the shift lowered the load, above q05 if it raised it. Dot: mean. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: 0.95 target.'
text.tspan: Safe-side share by phase of an injected load-shift: 3, 7, 15, and 30 day events, both groups, 24-120 h ahead
Safe side: below q95 if the shift lowered the load, above q05 if it raised it. Dot: mean. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: 0.95 target.
